requirements.evidence: config/services.php:40 adds 'mention_id' => env('DISCORD_MENTION_ID'); app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:72-75 appends "\n<@{$mention}>" on its own line and truncates the body to MaxContentLength - mb_strlen($suffix), so the mention survives and the total stays 1800; with no mention $suffix is '' so the old behavior is unchanged. mention() (lines 81-92) accepts string|int, trims, and requires '/\A\d{17,20}\z/' (\z rejects a trailing newline, and \d without the /u flag is ASCII-only). null/empty return null. .env.example, devops.md and logging.md are documented.

conventions.evidence: The change stays inside the existing App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert class with a private helper and private const, matching the sibling SecretKeyPattern constants. Docs are kept in sync (docs/ops/devops.md:61,70, docs/ops/logging.md:83) and CHANGELOG.md has an [Unreleased] entry. The class PHPDoc is updated. Tests are extended in tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php. No Livewire, Action or migration concerns apply.

security.evidence: The strict anchored regex '/\A\d{17,20}\z/' after trim blocks @everyone/@here and newline injection ("123...\n@everyone", "123...> \n@everyone"), and is_string/is_int guards drop bool, float and array values. Existing redaction and webhook-URL-free logging are untouched.

tests.evidence: DiscordOpsAlertTest.php adds tests for: an exact-content mention on its own last line with a trimmed id, an integer id, null/''/'   ' giving exactly "T\nM", a large invalid dataset ('@everyone', '@here', 'abc', '123', 16 and 21 digits, newline-injection cases, fullwidth digits, true, 1.5, an array), and truncation keeping length 1800 with the mention at the end. The pre-existing tests are left intact.

simplicity.evidence: About 20 lines of production code: one constant, one small mention() helper, and a two-line change in formatContent reusing the existing mb_substr truncation.

readability.evidence: Clear names (SnowflakePattern, mention(), $suffix), a docblock on mention(), and style consistent with the sibling constants. No dead code.

scope.evidence: Every edited file (.env.example, CHANGELOG.md, DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php, two ops docs, the test file) serves the task. No allowed_mentions or role-mention work, which are out of scope.

issues.explanation: The 'not configured' dataset includes '   ' (whitespace only), which goes slightly beyond the spec; it is harmless and correct, but it overlaps with the invalid-id test.

review.summary: The change adds services.discord.mention_id / DISCORD_MENTION_ID, checks it with a strict ASCII 17-20 digit anchored regex after trimming, and appends '<@id>' on its own line while reserving room for it within the 1800-character limit. It also updates .env.example, both ops docs and CHANGELOG, and adds thorough tests covering valid, empty, malicious and truncation cases. It is lean, correct and on scope, so I would approve it as is.
